visual_review: All 14 figure previews inspected. Fixed cases, six field components and all seed points retained. No visual or numerical restyling requested.

warning_review.FONT-GLYPH-FLOOR: Actual exported PDFs pass the 5 pt audit.
warning_review.EXPORT-RASTER: Some inherited plotters provide PNG rather than TIFF; editable PDF/SVG are present. This code audit did not change the artwork export contract.
warning_review.FINAL-WIDTH: Inherited dimensions are algebraic expressions; actual dimensions retained and checked in renders.
warning_review.UNCERTAINTY-ENCODING: Figure 12 is one disclosed selected-seed image plate, not a population mean.
warning_review.LOG-GUARD: Unused legacy training routine in shared spatial module; the active training plot asserts finite positive losses.
